summary: BC Partners Lending Corporation completed its previously announced acquisition of Alternative Credit Income Fund on September 29, 2026, via a two-step merger under the February 24, 2026 agreement; ACIF merged into Merger Sub and then into the Company, which survives. Concurrently, the Company's Great Lakes subsidiary amended its revolving credit facility, raising commitments from $125 million to $200 million, extending the revolving period to September 2029 and maturity to September 2031, with an accordion to $400 million. The filing omits per-share terms, premium and advisor details; watch integration, leverage and facility covenants.
